Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 8: the slip of [[IL-19 (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“While at a non-Hoth site, adds one [Light Side Force]. If just forfeited, may use 1 Force to place IL-19 in Used Pile.”), word for word the text of [[IL-19]]. The label under the slip reads “ M-HYD ‘Binary’ Droid (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>bb70257deeb8f4e3a728b1dc233dca01e96e3f6b8124e95ed04ad3a8f75e98d3</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[403, 513, 587, 758]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B2).
